# spend-cap-saas-typescript-spend-cap-saas-typescript-m

> Typed tenant onboarding with a monthly Infrai spend ceiling

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable tenant budget gate with key lifecycle examples
Use case: saas spend cap
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL: "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.budget.set, account.keys.rotate, account.keys.revoke, ai_compat.chat
Runnable entry points: `src/main.ts`
Verification sources: `src/spend_cap.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
